posts.text: Your Ramblers 11 for today’s busy of @EccleshallFC https://t.co/v6bYv0pV8W

It’s a lovely day here at The Sandbach Community Football Centre where we host @EccleshallFC in @nwcfl Division One South, get yourself down for what promises to be a cracking game. Team sheet coming soon…….

3RD V 4TH as the Ramblers look to capitalise on their home form and continue the 5 game unbeaten run. Whilst Eccleshall will want to cause an upset and continue their 4 game winning streak.   Should be a cracker of a game. https://t.co/gQU2LcEDkX
Thank you @CheadleNomads for the usual good hospitality 👏🏻
We hear from the Dec and JKD after the game. https://t.co/PLHAJJLSGX
FT 3-3 feels like a loss conceding so late but credit nomads for not giving up

A free kick delivered by AJ for nomads floats in finds a team mate who heads across goal and it’s nodded in at close range 

3-3 

Seconds to play
The Subs from Sandbach have completely changed this game
Chance for Fowles but AJ makes it tough for him and Fowles can’t quite get the shot around the keeper.

2-3 as Foley grabs a brace after Hatton works hard to win the ball and places a killer ball through for Foley to slot in beyond the closing keeper. 

77’ gone https://t.co/VVr1enVhGD
